periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation slanting approximately 45 degrees inward toward the snout
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending further from the geometric center than the top

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape profile at the posterior margin
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distance between the ear patches is roughly equal to the width of a single ear patch
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the top of both pinnae

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable brownish/rufous discoloration on the white fur of the lateral flank
